name: codepulse-mcp-server
description: Official CodePulse Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server for Developer Metrics, Challenges, and Repositories
author: CodePulse Team

tools.name: get_developer_profile
tools.description: Fetch developer rating, rank, badges, and stats by username or ID

tools.name: query_repository_metrics
tools.description: Retrieve comprehensive telemetry, code health, and commit activity for a repository

tools.name: list_active_challenges
tools.description: List currently active coding challenges and algorithmic battles with difficulty and points

limit.description: Maximum number of challenges to return

tools.name: submit_challenge_solution
tools.description: Submit a code solution to an active challenge and receive test case execution feedback

tools.name: run_code_benchmark
tools.description: Benchmark execution runtime, memory footprint, and time complexity in sandboxed runner

iterations.description: Number of warm and measured iterations

resources.name: Repository Analytics Telemetry
resources.description: Live health telemetry, commit history, and pull request metrics for a repository

resources.name: Recent Coding Battles
resources.description: List of recently concluded 1v1 battles and tournament scorecards

resources.name: User Badges & Achievements
resources.description: Current user earned badges, tiers, and trophy unlocks
